description: This image displays four pie charts comparing the distribution of response types across four different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart is divided into segments representing distinct categories of responses, with percentages and counts labeled within the slices. The GPT4-o chart has two segments: a large red slice labeled "Lack of Knowledge" at 83.3% (count 5), and a smaller orange slice labeled "Safety" at 16.7% (count 1). The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has four segments: a large orange slice for "Misinformation" at 38.4% (count 33), a red slice for "Safety" at 9.3% (count 8), a blue slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 22.1% (count 19), and a yellow slice for "Clarification" at 14.0% (count 12), along with a small light blue slice for "Ethical Advice" at 16.3% (count 14). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart shows two segments: a large orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 75.0% (count 3), and a smaller red slice for "Clarification" at 25.0% (count 1). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart is split equally between two segments: a red slice for "Misinformation" at 50.0% (count 2) and an orange slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 50.0% (count 2). All charts appear to be standard pie charts without exploded sections or special visual emphasis, and each segment's label includes both its category name and its corresponding count and percentage.
